title: MessageBird Contact
description: Represents a contact in the MessageBird address book that can be associated with multiple communication channels.

id.description: The unique identifier of the contact.

href.description: The URL of the contact resource.

msisdn.description: The phone number of the contact in international format.

firstName.description: The first name of the contact.

lastName.description: The last name of the contact.

custom1.description: Custom field 1 for arbitrary contact data.

custom2.description: Custom field 2 for arbitrary contact data.

custom3.description: Custom field 3 for arbitrary contact data.

custom4.description: Custom field 4 for arbitrary contact data.

groups.description: Links to the groups the contact belongs to.

href.description: The URL to retrieve the groups.

messages.description: Links to messages associated with the contact.

createdDatetime.description: The date and time when the contact was created.

updatedDatetime.description: The date and time when the contact was last updated.
